profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Cisco
profile.summary: My name is Anthony Lee and I am currently a student at Virginia Tech majoring in Computer Engineering. During my time in high school, I was able to participate in Boy Scouts and achieve the rank of Eagle Scout. This experience allowed me to work on my leadership, organizational, and team collaboration skills. Other skills I possess include the basics of computer programming in Java, Microsoft Office, and Google Suite. I hope to gain more experience in my field by participating in a internship over the summer.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Work on the MIG Routing Team that works on the SDK for Silicon One Products
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP)

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Graduate Teaching Assistant for ECE 2514 Computational Engineering, an introductory C++ course. Responsible for writing Autograder scripts for assignments and projects, holding office hours, and assisting the professor during lectures.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Computer Science · Communication

company.name: Virginia Tech Bradley Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Working on creating a new educational platform that integrates Extended Reality, Artificial Intelligence (Large Language Models), and the Digital Twin concept. My research focuses on creating this education tool for cybersecurity education within critical infrastructures such as water treatment plants. Tools being used include OpenAI's API, Unity and C#, and Meta Quest 2 VR Headset.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Large Language Models (LLM)

company.name: Virginia Tech Department of Computer Science

positions.title: HokieVision Production Engineer/Assistant
positions.description: Currently working as an Production Engineer/Assistant in Virginia Tech's Athletics Video Department (HokieVision). We are responsible for filming sports events at Virginia Tech that are streamed to ESPN and its affiliated networks. Responsibilities include building cameras and production sets, helping in various roles behind the scenes, and troubleshooting issues during live TV productions.

positions.title: Software Engineer II Technical Graduate Intern
positions.locationName: Morrisville, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Worked on migrating the Cisco Jenkins testing automation platform to support Cisco Silicon One Project development at the North Carolina Office. This included creating infrastructure needed in our labs and learning the technical details from the team responsible for this platform, and providing a TOI (Transfer of Information) session to my team about the platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Traffic Management · Internet network · GitHub · Git · PDB · gdb

positions.title: Software Engineer II Technical Graduate Intern
positions.locationName: Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Programmed Back-End software for a commercial router as part of Cisco's Silicon One Project. More specifically I implemented test cases that ensure proper resource allocation and internet traffic meter behavior within SDK P100 ASIC using Python and worked on a bug fix related to maximum resource size capacity for resource entries on SDK P100 ASIC using C++. All coding was done through a Linux environment. The router I worked on is currently being beta-tested with companies, such as Google, before public release.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Python (Programming Language) · Secure Shell (SSH) · Linux · Computer Science · Communication

company.name: Hume Center for National Security and Technology at Virginia Tech

positions.title: Information Technology Summer Intern
positions.description: Worked as a part of PepsiCo’s IT Executive Support team to enhance IT technical support for senior executives. My responsibilities were to provide rapid tech support for technologies used throughout PepsiCo facilities (Poly and Avocor video conferencing systems). On top of that, I successfully imaged new batch of MacBook Pros for PepsiCo Design Center office employees and supported a global IT support initiative within the company.

positions.title: Undergraduate Learning Assistant
positions.description: As a ULA for the introductory C++ course (ECE 2514), my job is to help guide students through this course by holding office hours where they can have their questions answered. In addition, I also grade the student’s assignments and provide detailed feedback on what they did incorrectly.

company.name: Virginia Tech Bradley Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering

positions.title: STEM Director
positions.description: In charge of the STEM Area at Camp Winnebago. My duties included teaching a variety of STEM-related merit badges, teaching scouts about 3D printing and CAD programs, and supervising staff members.

company.name: Patriots' Path Council, Boy Scouts of America

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: As a crew member, my duties included taking customers' orders and preparing the orders in a timely manner. In addition, my goal was to provide satisfactory customer service and resolve any issues with the customers in the best way possible.

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description: Spent two years on the website sub-division using code to build our team’s website to provide information to parents and sponsors. Spent the following two years on the electrical subdivision, which wired up the competition robot in a safe manner and installed electrical parts.

positions.title: Camp Counselor
positions.description: As a camp counselor, I engaged with young kids throughout the camp and taught skills required to complete Boy Scout merit badges. In addition, I supervised scouts during many different camp-wide activities and ensured they were being safe at all times.

company.name: Boy Scouts of America, Camp Nobebosco

honors.title: Johnson Fellowship
honors.description: This scholarship was established to recognize outstanding full-time students in the Electrical and Computer Engineering department who have maintained a strong academic record throughout their graduate program.

honors.title: IC CAE Scholar
honors.issuer: Issued by Intelligence Community Centers for Academic Excellence · May 2023
